principle_violations.reason: This code violates the Interface Segregation Principle because the CreditPaymentProcessor class is forced to implement the auth_sms method, even though it does not use it.
principle_violations.suggestion: In order to comply with the Interface Segregation Principle create another abstract class (e.g. SMSAuthorizer) that implements the auth_sms method and implements the PaymentProcessor class. So the CreditPaymentProcessor can use the PaymentProcessor and the DebitPaymentProcessor can use the SMSAuthorizer.

principle_violations.reason: This code violates the Single Responsibility Principle because the order class is responsible for both prices and quantities.
principle_violations.suggestion: Split the Order class into two separate classes: one for the order quantities and one for the prices.
